The following events took place in '''34 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Westa Impeveri]] defeated [[Karid Blakken]] in an election for senior counselor of the [[Hedrett]] Town Council.<ref name="lfc">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
*Dark Jedi [[Karae Nalvas]] seduces [[Alec (Jedi)|Alec's]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Saren Valek]] to the dark side and starts training Valek. Alec will chase Nalvas and Valek for years.<ref name="cp">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Clouded Paths}}</ref>
*[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] meets fellow [[Apprentice Legislator/Legends|Apprentice Legislator]] [[Silya Shessaun/Legends|Silya Shessaun]] at a summit on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Shessaun">{{DB|character|silyashessaun|Shessaun, Silya}}</ref>
*Amidala ceases to be Apprentice Legislator and becomes the [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
*[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] saves [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] life by preventing him from eating [[Konkeel pie]] during an official banquet organized by [[Hewett]] [[Senator/Legends|senators]].<ref name="Episode I Adventures 4: Jedi Emergency">''[[Episode I Adventures 4: Jedi Emergency]]''</ref>
*[[Dren Melne]] returns to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] after working as a mercenary pilot and starts a relationship with [[Essara Till/Legends|Essara Till]], a fellow ex-mercenary pilot.<ref name="The Starfighter Trap">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>
